experiment: C1 confirmatory synthetic concept cohort v1
scope_note: English-only internal confirmation; multilingual generalization is out of scope.

corpus_generation.rule: Generate four discovery and two held-out user requests per concept; scenarios and wording must differ while the requested explanatory concept remains fixed.

quality_gates.manual_review_before_activation: Record a pass/fail reason for topic adherence, named entities, product names, scenario duplication, and hard-negative contamination. Never inspect SAE, AV, AR, or endpoint values. A failure stops v1 rather than editing or selectively regenerating a document.

reference_templates: This feature responds to explanations of {title}, especially {summary}.
The represented concept is {title}: it concerns {summary}.
Activation is associated with passages about {title}, including {summary}.
